request.spec:
Show a due-total per calendar month: for every month (yyyy-mm) that any claim on the sheet is
dated in, the due of the claims dated in that month that count.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show a due-total per calendar month: for every month (yyyy-mm) that any claim on the sheet is
dated in, the due of the claims dated in that month that count.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The sheet now shows a due-total for each calendar month, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

- **Which months appear:** every month (yyyy-mm) that any claim on the sheet is dated in, in date order. That includes claims that don't count, such as drafts or voided ones. Each total is shown as `month-<yyyy-mm>-due-total` with two decimals.
- **What each total adds up:** only the dues of the claims dated in that month that count, using the same rule as the existing per-tag totals. A month whose claims don't count shows `0.00`.

The change is front-end only: no stored data, server or audit changes were needed. It's a new `useMonthDueTotals` in `src/main/frontend/features/claims/claims.ts`, modelled on the per-tag `useTagDueTotals`, and a new list next to the tag totals in `rollup.slot.tsx`.
